title: Smart Data Models - PMD Core Ontology - ManufacturingProcess
description: A planned process that is driven by the primary intent to transform objects A manufacturing process is always a transformative process. (PMD Core Ontology 3.1.2 class 'manufacturing process', https://w3id.org/pmd/co/PMD_0000833. Entity type and attribute names are the PascalCase / camelCase forms of the English rdfs:labels; context.jsonld maps them to the PMDco, BFO, RO, IAO and OBI IRIs.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ManufacturingProcess'

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. The name of this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. A description of this item.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

pmdClass.description: Property. Not a PMDco term (Smart Data Models addition) standing for rdf:type: the PMDco classes this entity is an instance of, given by their English rdfs:label, verbatim. Enum of the 68 non-deprecated classes of the 'manufacturing process' branch (pmd:PMD_0000833, the root and all subclasses in PMDco 3.1.2, including subclasses that PMDco only states through owl:intersectionOf). Several values are allowed (e.g. a material that is both 'steel' and 'structural material').

hasSpecifiedInput.description: Relationship. Model:'http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OBI_0000293'. PMDco 'has specified input': The inverse property of is specified input of Points to the Material or Object entities that enter the process (primary inputs).

hasSpecifiedOutput.description: Relationship. Model:'http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OBI_0000299'. PMDco 'has specified output': The inverse property of is specified output of Points to the Material or Object entities that the process produces (primary outputs).

hasParticipant.description: Relationship. Model:'http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_0000057'. PMDco 'has participant': a relation between a process and a continuant, in which the continuant is somehow involved in the process Points to Device entities (and agents such as Organization entities) that take part in the process.

processAttribute.description: Property. Not a PMDco term (Smart Data Models addition) standing for rdf:type: the English rdfs:label of the PMDco process attribute class, one of the 26 classes under 'process attribute' (pmd:PMD_0000008).

hasSpecifiedNumericValue.description: Property. Model:'http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OBI_0001937'. PMDco 'has specified numeric value': A relation between a value specification and a number that quantifies it. The number of the scalar value specification.

hasMeasurementUnitLabel.description: Property. Model:'http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000039'. PMDco 'has measurement unit label'. The unit IRI. PMDco does not define units itself; its patterns use QUDT (http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/...) or UO units. QUDT unit IRIs are recommended, e.g. http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/MegaPA.

hasProcessAttribute.description: Property. Model:'https://w3id.org/pmd/co/PMD_0000009'. PMDco 'has process attribute': A relation between a process and a process attribute that depends on it. Flattened: each item gives the process attribute class (e.g. heating rate, deformation speed), the number and the unit.

hasFirstInstant.description: Property. Model:'http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_0000222'. PMDco/BFO 'has first instant': the first instant of the temporal interval that the process occupies. Flattened from the PMDco 'temporal region' pattern (process occupies temporal region, which has first/last instant, given by time:inXSDDateTime). ISO 8601 date-time, or a date when only the day is known.

hasLastInstant.description: Property. Model:'http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_0000224'. PMDco/BFO 'has last instant': the last instant of the temporal interval that the process occupies. Flattened from the PMDco 'temporal region' pattern (process occupies temporal region, which has first/last instant, given by time:inXSDDateTime). ISO 8601 date-time, or a date when only the day is known.

precededBy.description: Relationship. Model:'http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_0000062'. PMDco 'preceded by': x is preceded by y if and only if the time point at which y ends is before or equivalent to the time point at which x starts. Formally: x preceded by y iff ω(y) <= α(x), where α is a function that maps a process to a start point, and ω is a function that maps a process to an end point. Points to ManufacturingProcess or Assay entities that come before this one in a process chain.

precedes.description: Relationship. Model:'http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/BFO_0000063'. PMDco 'precedes': x precedes y if and only if the time point at which x ends is before or equivalent to the time point at which y starts. Formally: x precedes y iff ω(x) <= α(y), where α is a function that maps a process to a start point, and ω is a function that maps a process to an end point. Points to ManufacturingProcess or Assay entities that come after this one in a process chain.

isSubjectOf.description: Property. Model:'https://w3id.org/pmd/co/PMD_0000004'. PMDco 'is subject of': Inverse of 'is about'. Flattened: in PMDco the process is subject of (and realizes a plan that concretizes) a directive information entity such as a test standard or a plan specification; here each item is the title or designation of that document (e.g. DIN EN ISO 6892-1).
